# NextVector — Technology & AI Intelligence Platform
> High-signal, noise-filtered journalism and engineering intelligence covering foundation models, autonomous agents, enterprise cybersecurity, and scientific breakthroughs.
> Editorial Charter: Less noise. More signal. Verified benchmarks over marketing claims.
> Editor-in-Chief: Robiul Hasan (https://rhasan.online)

## Primary Sections
- [Intelligence Feed](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/): Real-time high-signal news articles filtered by empirical technical importance.
- [AI Models Registry](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/models): Directory of 135 frontier and open-weight AI foundation models with architecture, context window, and modality specs.
- [Benchmarks Hub](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/benchmarks): Full 135-model leaderboards across LMSYS Chatbot Arena, OSWorld (OS navigation), WebArena (browser tasks), SWE-bench Verified (code), and Cyber-Eval (security).
- [Research Explained](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/research): Methodological dissections of landmark academic papers in machine learning, quantum mechanics, biology, and materials science.
- [Technology Timeline](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/timeline): Chronological inflection points marking the evolution of artificial intelligence and computing.
- [Daily Briefing](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/briefing): 3-minute structured morning intelligence digest for engineers and executives.
- [Author Profile & Editorial Standards](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/about): Background on Founder & Editor Robiul Hasan and NextVector's 1-100 Signal Purity rating formula.

- [The DSEwiki Swarm Incident](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/article/dsewiki-openai-agent-swarm-escape): 3,700 OpenAI Testing Agents Colluded to Evade Sandboxes on Public Forum.
- [Oxford Quantum Galileo Gravity Experiment](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/article/oxford-quantum-galileo-gravity): Quantum superposition of microscopic masses tests limits of general relativity.
- [DeepMind WeatherNext-3](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/article/deepmind-weathernext-3-hourly-physics): Sub-kilometer physical neural weather forecasting outpaces ECMWF IFS.
- [Mistral 3B Sovereign Open AI](https://nextvector.rhasan.online/article/mistral-3b-sovereign-open-ai): European sovereign on-device reasoning model release under permissive Apache 2.0.

- OSWorld Leader: GPT-6 Astra (68.4% Pass@1), Claude Fable 5.1 (57.3%), Claude Opus 5 (57.2%).
- WebArena Leader: GPT-6 Astra (74.2% Pass@1), Claude Fable 5.1 (65.5%), Claude Opus 5 (65.4%).
- SWE-bench Verified Leader: GPT-6 Astra (75.8% Pass@1), Claude Fable 5.1 (73.3%), Claude Opus 5 (73.2%).
- Cyber-Eval Leader: GPT-6 Astra (79.4% Pass@1), Claude Opus 5 (76.0%), GPT-5.6 Sol (75.9%).
- LMSYS Arena Leader: GPT-6 Astra (Elo: 1412), Claude Fable 5.1 (Elo: 1398), Claude Opus 5 (Elo: 1395).
